checks.question: Total listening minutes for the top 5 genres.
checks.gold_sql: SELECT g.name AS genre, ROUND(SUM(t.milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS minutes FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY minutes DESC, genre LIMIT 5
